title: Vikram and Betal: The True Friend
moral: A true friend stays with you in difficult times.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about two friends.
scenes.text: While Vikram carried Betal, he told a story about two friends traveling together.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: A bear appears in the forest.
scenes.text: A bear came towards the two friends while they were walking in the forest.
scenes.image_prompt: bear approaching two scared friends in forest cartoon

scenes.summary: One friend runs away, the other pretends to be dead.
scenes.text: One friend climbed a tree while the other lay still on the ground.
scenes.image_prompt: one friend on tree and other lying on ground with bear cartoon

scenes.text: The bear sniffed the man on the ground and walked away.
scenes.image_prompt: bear sniffing man lying still cartoon

scenes.text: Vikram said a true friend does not leave you in danger. Betal flew away again.
scenes.image_prompt: betal flying back to tree while vikram stands firm cartoon

story: Betal told a story of two friends and a bear. One friend ran away while the other stayed calm and survived. Vikram said a true friend never leaves you in danger, and Betal flew away.
